library.name: Retailer 1 check library v1 (demo - derived from QA Automation handout, not the retailer's real export)

checks.name: Recording disclaimer
checks.description: Consent is a check, not an assumption: the recording disclaimer must be verified as read on every call. Source: handout p.4 (type A), p.5 worked example (critical, verbatim match), p.7.

checks.name: DMO read verbatim
checks.description: The DMO must be read verbatim. Source: handout p.4 (type A, DMO/VDO), p.5 worked example (critical).

checks.name: Rates and charges match plan
checks.description: The rate the agent quotes must equal the rate on the lead's plan. Source: handout p.4 (type B, rate quoted = rate on plan), p.5 worked example (critical; peak rate).

checks.name: Email captured matches CRM
checks.description: The email the agent reads back must match the CRM email field. Source: handout p.4 (type B), p.5 worked example (critical).

checks.name: Date of birth matches CRM
checks.description: The DOB stated on the call must match the CRM date-of-birth field. Source: handout p.4 (type B lists DOB; factual checks block the sale, so critical). DOB does not appear in the p.5 worked example.

checks.name: Dead air
checks.description: Coaching note only; never blocks the sale. Source: handout p.4 (type C, blocks sale: No), p.5 worked example (non-critical).
